== Hyde's Synthesizer ==

Please do not remove the reference to Hyde's synthesizer. The linked Wikipedia article has an explanation of what it is, and a citation with a link to the issue of Modern Electrics that has the article describing the synthesizer. You can scroll down to the page in the citation to see it. [[User:Augur|Augur]] ([[User talk:Augur|talk]]) 00:42, 14 June 2025 (UTC)

Also, to ensure no confusion: the PDF page of the article is 22-23, but the publication is volume numbered, and so the numbers printed on the page itself are 580-581. You can see that here: https://www.worldradiohistory.com/Archive-Modern-Electrics/Modern-Electrics-1912-09.pdf#page=22. I will edit the citation to link directly to these pages to avoid future confusion. [[User:Augur|Augur]] ([[User talk:Augur|talk]]) 00:56, 14 June 2025 (UTC)

::I am so confused what you're talking about, man, the citation literally links to a PDF with the article written BY HYDE and which describes the synthesizer. What do you MEAN it doesn't mention it?! [[User:Augur|Augur]] ([[User talk:Augur|talk]]) 21:19, 15 June 2025 (UTC)

::Are you talking about the Chadabe citation at the end of the sentence on Synthesizer, or the Modern Electrics citation in the paragraph linked to by my edit? The former does not mention Hyde's work, certainly, but the latter is a citation directly _of_ Hyde. [[User:Augur|Augur]] ([[User talk:Augur|talk]]) 21:32, 15 June 2025 (UTC)

== Moving Coil History? ==
The section on the history of the loud speaker mentions Siemens' improvements to earlier designs. If you look at the page for [[Werner_von_Siemens#Later_years]] it says that his work in 1877 was for a dynamic speaker. The section on the history of the loud speaker also describes this work as an improvement to a loud speaker (tho the Siemens page does not).

This seems to suggest that the Moving Coil section in History should actually begin with Siemens' work, not with Lodge's, given the 25 year lead. What were the functional differences between Lodge's design and Siemens' such that it makes sense to start with Lodge? [[User:Augur|Augur]] ([[User talk:Augur|talk]]) 20:47, 24 June 2025 (UTC)

== Founding Date ==

The article currently mentions a founding date of 1984, but patent filings for VPL's work were made as early as 1982, and the incorporation of VPL Research, Inc. happened in 1985, per links below.

What is the appropriate way to correct the article?

https://patents.google.com/patent/US4542291A/

https://bizfileonline.sos.ca.gov/search/business (search for "VPL Research" or for "1265316" (the corporate entity number)) [[User:Augur|Augur]] ([[User talk:Augur|talk]]) 05:47, 24 March 2026 (UTC)

== Hyde's Synthesizer ==

Please do not remove the reference to Hyde's synthesizer. The linked Wikipedia article has an explanation of what it is, and a citation with a link to the issue of Modern Electrics that has the article describing the synthesizer. You can scroll down to the page in the citation to see it. [[User:Augur|Augur]] ([[User talk:Augur|talk]]) 00:42, 14 June 2025 (UTC)

Also, to ensure no confusion: the PDF page of the article is 22-23, but the publication is volume numbered, and so the numbers printed on the page itself are 580-581. You can see that here: https://www.worldradiohistory.com/Archive-Modern-Electrics/Modern-Electrics-1912-09.pdf#page=22. I will edit the citation to link directly to these pages to avoid future confusion. [[User:Augur|Augur]] ([[User talk:Augur|talk]]) 00:56, 14 June 2025 (UTC)

::Are you talking about the Chadabe citation at the end of the sentence on Synthesizer, or the Modern Electrics citation in the paragraph linked to by my edit? The former does not mention Hyde's work, certainly, but the latter is a citation directly _of_ Hyde. [[User:Augur|Augur]] ([[User talk:Augur|talk]]) 21:32, 15 June 2025 (UTC)

== Moving Coil History? ==
The section on the history of the loud speaker mentions Siemens' improvements to earlier designs. If you look at the page for [[Werner_von_Siemens#Later_years]] it says that his work in 1877 was for a dynamic speaker. The section on the history of the loud speaker also describes this work as an improvement to a loud speaker (tho the Siemens page does not).

This seems to suggest that the Moving Coil section in History should actually begin with Siemens' work, not with Lodge's, given the 25 year lead. What were the functional differences between Lodge's design and Siemens' such that it makes sense to start with Lodge? [[User:Augur|Augur]] ([[User talk:Augur|talk]]) 20:47, 24 June 2025 (UTC)

== Founding Date ==

The article currently mentions a founding date of 1984, but patent filings for VPL's work were made as early as 1982, and the incorporation of VPL Research, Inc. happened in 1985, per links below.

What is the appropriate way to correct the article?

https://patents.google.com/patent/US4542291A/

in_the_discussion.connections: Their defense of Hyde’s synthesizer cites the same Modern Electrics article they added to Electronic musical instrument. user_page.judgment: They seem to present themselves as technically accomplished and intellectually curious, using matter-of-fact, occasionally self-deprecating userboxes to share a broad range of skills, interests, identities, and beliefs.

article_edit_history.judgment: Their edits seem mixed: useful typo corrections, link repairs, and cleanup accompany unsourced additions and cast reordering. Instrument-history priority claims rely on primary sourcing, while exoplanet revisions need stronger verification and more encyclopedic wording.

article_talk_history.judgment: They seem to focus on technology history, priority, and source accuracy, usually communicating directly and civilly with detailed references and clarifying questions.
